subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Shamanic Death
description: Learn Shamanic Death in one minute.

hook.text: Siberian shamans reported dying during initiation—their flesh stripped, bones rearranged, then reassembled.

buildup.text: The shaman's symbolic death grants access to the spirit world. You must die to the ordinary to see beyond.

discovery.text: Shamanic death echoes the hero's journey. Descent, ordeal, transformation, return. The structure mirrors myth.

twist.text: The shaman doesn't just visit death—they become its translator. They speak for both the living and dead.

climax.text: Shamanic traditions show resurrection as a technology, not a miracle. It's a learned skill with rules.

punchline.text: Die once to serve both worlds forever.

quiz.question: What does shamanic initiatory death grant?
